bullets.text: STL's Competitive Edge - **STL** leads UK's fiber and data center solutions, eyeing growth with hyperscalers.
UK Telcos Unite Against Scams - Major UK mobile providers launch a **Telecommunications Fraud Charter** to combat scam calls.
Job Cuts at BT - **BT** reduces workforce by 5,000 amid revenue decline, part of a £3 billion cost-saving strategy.
Open RAN Testing Expands - **Digital Catapult** adds six vendors to enhance Open RAN trials in the UK.
Telefónica Deutschland's Leadership Change - **Telefónica** appoints Santiago Argelich Hesse as new CEO amid strategic transformation.
AI Drives Telco Cloud Growth - **Omdia** forecasts a 12% increase in CSP cloud spending by 2025, driven by AI integration.
Cohere Technologies Innovates - **Cohere** enhances spectral efficiency for 4G and 5G, paving the way for future networks.
Satellite Connectivity in 5G - ESA's trial integrates satellite links into **5G** networks, enhancing connectivity for remote areas.
Apple's Satellite Features - **Apple** develops new satellite features for iPhones, enhancing connectivity in remote areas.
Fiber Expansion for AI - **Verizon** and **AWS** partner to build fiber routes to support growing AI bandwidth needs.
